insecticide: permethrin + deltamethrin + lambdacyhalothrin + etofenprox + cyfluthrin + DDT
source_text: A total of 130 mosquitoes that survived insecticide exposure were further subjected for kdr genotyping (both eastern and western variants). Kdr mutation alleles were not detected in all the samples that were tested and therefore sequencing was not performed.
